title: About
paragraphs: I am a research engineer based in Toulouse with 3+ years experience of building AI models for space surveillance.
My work combines deep learning, machine learning and mathematical optimization in various domains, mostly involving orbital mechanics.
Precedently, I researched orbital-maneuver detection and characterization, collision-risk assessment, visibility analysis and measurement simulation.

Beyond work I share open-source projects exploring satellite swarms control by reinforcement learning, deep clustering, RAG research assistants, ATC communication sentiment analysis, multi-agent debate, and more.
